name: Stromation Free - Contact Form to Inbox + Auto-Reply

parameters.content:
## Free: Contact Form to Inbox + Auto-Reply

When someone fills your website contact form, they get an instant friendly auto-reply and the lead lands in your inbox. No lead ever sits unseen, and every person hears back in seconds instead of hours.

This is the free taster from Stromation. If you like it, the Solopreneur Pro Pack has six more (missed-call text-back, AI lead follow-up, content multiplier, onboarding, morning digest, invoice recovery): stromation.com/pro-pack.html

### Setup (5 min, no API keys)
1. Point your form at the /webhook/contact-form URL of the first node. Send JSON like:
   { "name":"..", "email":"..", "message":"..", "website":"" }
   (the empty 'website' field is a honeypot - bots fill it, humans dont.)
2. Edit the CONFIG block in the Code node (your business name + your inbox).
3. Attach your SMTP or Gmail credential to BOTH Email nodes.
4. Activate. Submit your form once to test.

You own it. Runs on n8n, no monthly fee.
